    default · OB/GYN Read-only Unsaved changes
    1
    L1 / §5.2 — Definition switcher
    Opened from the visit-note icon rail at note level, not from inside one form's header. Floating modal over the note, so the chart stays in context.Retires: #27917 · #18574 · #21577 · #8687 · #3194 · #12831
    2
    L7 — Case scoping
    Defaults to All here and in chart view. IMS defaults to All from chart view but to the note's case from the note — same screen, different data by door.Retires: #6264 · #21631 · #27123
    3
    L6 — Uncapped, virtualized
    Full history with horizontal scroll and a frozen row-label column. No 4-visit cap, no 5-visit paging, no "No Visit Note" placeholder columns.Retires: #8763 · #16611 · #1157 · #11720
    4
    §5.3 — Orientation and graph toggle
    Orientation mirrors IMS Show VN in Row/Column, and editing works in both. Chart graphs every numeric row inside the grid rather than opening a second screen; a single row can be graphed on its own from the toggle in its label.Retires: #6702 · #3611 · gap not filed
    5
    L9 / §5.4 — Output is the deliverable
    Print, fax and export live in one menu rather than three toolbar buttons. Landscape follows content and pagination keeps a visit's columns together; one renderer serves screen, note, letter and PDF.Retires: #14889 · #26333 · #26167 · #31593 · #27992 · #8614 · #3778 · #4133

    Editing in place · changes save to the observation store and sync to the source form
